mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psp_bank_mapping ( id, psp_id, country_code, currency, bank_code, psp_bank_code, status, sort, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{pspId}, #{countryCode}, #{currency}, #{bankCode}, #{pspBankCode}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), psp_bank_code = #{pspBankCode}, status = #{status}, sort = #{sort}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}
